ledger: Man (real, back to camera) | dark slicked-back hair, clean-shaven, white button-down shirt, holding small gray comb in right hand | identical appearance; still standing at bathroom mirror facing frame-right, comb in right hand | Stays in fixed position at mirror throughout; action cycles: combing mustache/upper-lip area with head tilted back (00:00-00:01.5), raising comb to right temple/hairline and combing hair back with head bowed (00:02.0-00:04.0), returning comb to cheek/mustache/jaw (00:04.5-00:09.1), raising comb toward temple again at 00:09.6; all hand/head transitions occur within plausible motion time between frames; no wardrobe, hair, or identity changes

Man's mirror reflection (same character, front view) | matches real man's face, hair, white shirt, right-hand comb | matches at end; still synchronized in posture and action | Reflection mirrors head tilt and comb location in essentially every sampled frame (mustache 00:00-00:01.5, hairline 00:02.0-00:04.0, chin/jaw 00:05.0-00:09.1); one possible lag at 00:09.625 where the real comb has reached the temple while the reflected comb appears lower near the nose/mid-face

findings.description: In the final frame the real man has raised the comb to his right temple/hairline (tip visibly above eye level at the hairline), while the mirror reflection shows the comb held roughly horizontal at nose/mid-face level, lagging behind the real hand position. At every earlier sampled frame the reflection matches the real comb height (e.g., 00:02.041 both at hairline), so this single-frame mismatch is unexplained by the continuous raising motion. Confidence is limited because the reflected comb is small and partially occluded by the hand.
